_comment: Canned decisions for --llm scripted:FILE. Lets the discovery loop, recorder, replay and tests run without an API key. Refs are resolved on screen by role+name so the script does not depend on enumeration order.

decisions.reasoning: sign-on form: enter the operator user id
enter the member number to look up
read the savings balance from the detail frame
savings balance for the member has been read

NO MEMBER FOUND.message: No member exists with that number
NO MEMBER FOUND.reasoning: the search page reports the number is unknown; a legitimate answer for the caller

SESSION EXPIRED.reasoning: the host shows an idle-timeout interstitial; CONTINUE restores the session, then redo the search

distillation.name: member_savings_balance
distillation.description: Sign on to the core banking console, look up a member by number and return the current savings balance.

parameter_descriptions.member_id: Member number as shown on the member card (digits only)
parameter_descriptions.operator_user: Operator user id for the console

step_descriptions.s06: Read savings balance from the detail frame
